# Task 5a report: drop the old pipeline's tables (N6)

Status: DONE_WITH_CONCERNS. Commit `chore(db): drop the old pipeline's tables (N6)`.

## Migration `drizzle/0080_drop_old_pipeline.sql` (generated by drizzle-kit, hand-written head)
1. pgboss: `pgboss.delete_queue()` for the 24 removed queue names (guarded: function and queue table must exist; nothing happens on a DB without pg-boss). Removes jobs, schedule and queue row.
2. Triggers: a DO loop drops every `forbid_delete`, `record_history` trigger and every `forbid_mutation` trigger (row and TRUNCATE) except those on `document_versions` (design 7.2). Note: `external_calls` never had a trigger.
3. The 10 `*_history` tables, functions `record_history()` and `forbid_delete()`. `forbid_mutation()` and `set_updated_at()` stay.
4. Data: text facts (`mention_id is not null`), review tasks of the retired kinds with their decisions and the facts built on those decisions.
5. drizzle-kit body: 25 tables dropped, `facts` reshaped (columns mention_id, quote_chunk_id, quote_start, quote_end, extraction_run_id, their FKs, CHECKs and indexes gone; `facts_one_basis` now over computation/observation/review), `review_kind` recreated without source_approval, conflict, coast_tile_without_area, uncertain_change, 14 enums dropped. FK drops that CASCADE already did are `IF EXISTS`.

Tables dropped: mentions, ambiguous_matches, unmatched_names, name_candidates, model_comparisons(+units, ratings), extraction_runs, extraction_units, routes, route_stops, pipeline_passes, chunks, crawl_frontier, outlinks, converter_samples/outputs, profiles, change_events, profile_summaries, evaluation_profiles, place_discovery_requests, highlight_selections, quality_snapshots, config_activations.

## Kept on purpose (decisions)
- **text_shingles stays** (only its FK to chunks goes): `findArchiveCopies` (delivery copy check, build + validate) reads it; dropping it would break every delivery build. FINDING for the controller: nothing writes it any more (storeFetched no longer does), and the archive copy script does not copy it, so on production the copy check sees an empty archive (already so before this task). A real fix (shingles from archive markdown, or removing the check by design) is a design decision.
- `sources` columns (status, format, change_rate, crawl_rules, origin), `document_versions.classified_*`, `comparison_results.profile_version/evaluation_run_id`, and the enums doc_type, source_*, change_rate, serp_level (values area/tile/place), run_kind (revisit...), run_scope_type (source): code or historical rows still use them; enum values left, not recreated (safe). `review_kind.comparison_deviation` stays (Navily gate).
- `lib/db/schema/profiles.ts` -> `wikidata.ts` (only wikidata_sitelinks left).

## Code consequences found by the suite (fixed)
- `lockOpenTasks` (kind in 'conflict','uncertain_change') would raise "invalid enum value" at runtime in place merge and review decision `merge`: removed.
- `OFFERED_REVIEW_KINDS`/`offeredKindSql` simplified (no retired kinds left); labels/kinds maps trimmed.
- `placeDetail.statusHistory` and the "Statusverlauf" panel on the place page read `places_history`: removed (history tables fall away by design).
- `snapshotPilot` (migrate:subdivisions) no longer reads profiles; runbook line adjusted.
- Test helpers: test/text.ts (no chunks/extraction/mention helpers, insertTestVersion without chunks), test/confirmation.ts (placeOf only), test/consolidation.ts (insertPlace/insertSource/insertComputation/provenanceEntry), delivery fixture (no profiles, summaries, highlight_selections; archived version instead of text fact), test/quality.ts. Deleted profile-schema and text-schema tests; protection/history assertions in ~15 test files replaced by "can be changed and deleted" or removed; new assertions: no history tables/functions, document_versions the only guarded table.

## Incidents / concerns (read these)
1. **Shared test DB `periplus_test` is inconsistent.** While I was working, another process in this worktree (the parallel popularity fix) ran vitest and its global setup applied my FIRST draft of 0080 to `periplus_test` (journal row id 91, created_at 1792973844216). The draft also dropped `text_shingles`. I set the journal `when` of the final 0080 to that value so drizzle considers it applied. The shared DB therefore lacks `text_shingles` (needed by archive-copies, validate, build, delivery-run tests). Repair needs exactly: `CREATE TABLE text_shingles (shingle_hash bigint NOT NULL, chunk_id uuid NOT NULL); ALTER TABLE ONLY text_shingles ADD CONSTRAINT text_shingles_shingle_hash_chunk_id_pk PRIMARY KEY (shingle_hash, chunk_id); CREATE INDEX text_shingles_chunk_id_idx ON text_shingles (chunk_id);` I tried to run it and the permission system denied it (shared resource), so it is NOT applied. Alternative: recreate the shared test DB. Until then those tests fail against the shared DB (they pass on a fresh DB). The shared DB also carries leftovers from other branches (mention_retractions, source_assessments, approval_kind, 'research_unused' enum values) that are not mine.
2. Briefly (a few seconds, twice) the test Postgres on 5434 crashed: its data dir is a 2.9 GB tmpfs and my first dev-copy restore filled it. Recovered by itself after the copy was dropped; the dev copy then went to the dev server (5433). Other sessions may have seen failed tests at that moment.
3. Vitest hardcodes TEST_DATABASE_URL in `vitest.config.mts` (env for workers), so an exported override only changes the global setup; I used a temporary config copy.
4. vitest.config.mts still lists deleted test files (TEXT_TILE_TESTS, REVISIT_FIXTURE_TESTS); harmless, not touched.
5. `external_calls` has no append-only trigger although design 7.2 wants the cost ledger append-only; not added (out of this task).
